name: Stitching (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Price +6,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These special suits of armor were originally developed to reduce the burden on combat healers in dwarven fortresses, though their utility is universal. The first time each day you would be reduced to less than 0 hit points while wearing this armor you are healed for 3d8+ 5 points of damage.

If this would leave you with a hit point total greater than zero, you remain conscious and aware as though your hit point total had never fallen below zero. If your hit point total is still less than zero after this healing you are unconscious but stable.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure moderate wounds
